units.source_text: 我是坐在仰卧的名人身旁拍摄的，名人没有枕枕头，脸庞稍微隆起，侧脸显得有点斜仰，饶有风采。

en.t: I took the photograph while sitting beside the master as he lay on his back; he had no pillow under his head, his face was slightly raised, and in profile it tilted a little upward, with a striking air of distinction.

units.source_text: 那明显凸出的颚骨和微张的大嘴尤其引人注目。

en.t: His clearly protruding jawbone and his large, slightly open mouth were especially arresting.

units.source_text: 鼻子高大得令人望而生畏。

en.t: His nose was so high and large that it inspired awe at a glance.

units.source_text: 从合上眼睑的皱褶到额头浓重的阴影，都露出深深的哀愁。

en.t: From the folds of his closed eyelids to the heavy shadows on his forehead, everything revealed a profound sorrow.
